meta.title: Team category picker with categories that share a name

plan.title: Duplicate Category Names in Team Picker

steps.note: Enable the required PR team-filtering configuration before inspecting team categories.

args.goal: Open Teams > All Categories > Edit Team on the Buyer portal and inspect the category picker; verify that categories with the same name are each distinguishable by their displayed code or other unique identifying information, and stop when the screen proves every duplicate-name category can be told apart.

steps.note: No catalog domain step reaches or asserts the Teams category picker, so perform and verify this buyer-side screen interaction directly.
Confirm the inspected screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or undefined values after the category check.
